title: Bengaluru - BBMP plan sanction (seed)
verify: Confirm against the current BBMP plan-sanction checklist and the Sakala service requirements before submitting. The sheet list, the paper size and the statutory fields below are all seeds.

sheets.note: Site / key plan with the plot dimensioned against the abutting road.
One plan per storey, including any basement and the terrace.
At least one section through the stair.
Door and window schedule. Useful for the contractor; not known to be demanded at sanction.
FAR, coverage and setbacks against the sanctioned limits.

statutoryFields.label: KHATA NO.
statutoryFields.note: BBMP khata (A-khata / B-khata) identifying the property on the corporation register.

statutoryFields.label: WARD NO.
statutoryFields.note: BBMP ward the property falls in.

statutoryFields.label: ARCH. REG. NO.
statutoryFields.note: Council of Architecture registration of the architect signing the set.

statutoryFields.label: OWNER
statutoryFields.note: Owner as recorded on the khata, for the signature block.

declarations: The plan conforms to the BBMP Building Bye-laws 2020 and to the National Building Code 2016 as applicable.
All dimensions are in millimetres unless noted otherwise. Do not scale off this drawing.
